### 4. Computations
**A. Returned-wire refund (agent).** Return is Larkspur-side: settlement agent rejection, returned 410708.95 ≠ funding wire 419566.95 ("Larkspur's wrong amount").
- First lost day (first_lost_day_of_returned_wire): date the rejected wire went out = 2026-09-24.
- Re-send days (resend_days_of_resend_standard): came in 11:30 ≤ 12:00 → 1.
- Re-review days (rereview_days_of_resend_standard): wrong-amount rejection → VA condition review turn time = 1 (loan docs: "Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 3 | 1 | ...").
- Relock days (relock_days_of_resend_standard): expiration before relock = original 09-25 (no extension); re-send+re-review span from Mon 09-28 = 2 business days → ends 09-29; 09-25 is on/after return date and ≤ 09-29 → relock needed; request 09:40 ≤ lock desk cutoff 16:00 (lock docs, 45-Day) → confirmation business days = 1.
- Standard 1+1+1 = 3 business days from 09-28 → last day Wed 09-30. Last lost day (last_lost_day_of_returned_wire): funding wire 10-01 later than 09-30 → 09-30.
- Lost days 09-24..09-30 = 7 (within charge). Refund 7 × 86.07 = **602.49**, period **2026-09-24..2026-09-30**, daily **86.07**, source 5faf8448….
- Fall-back (returned_wire_refund_amount alone): no first/last lost day stated by it → "the refund is zero" — definite, different.

**B. Redraw fee refund (agent).** Latest doc redraw fee charge 250.00 (09-14).
- Base price (redraw_base_price_by_package_format): Hybrid eClosing, consent 08-31 ≤ signing 09-16 → 110.00.
- Rush (rush_redraw_add_on): booked Mon 09-14, business days 09-15, 09-16 = 2 = Hybrid draw lead → 25.00.
- Rider (rider_redraw_add_on): townhouse → 15.00.
- Program addenda: VA → 10.00.
- Package price 160.00; signer-set (signer_set_redraw_pricing): 2 borrowers, 6 seats → 160 + 10 = 170.00.
- Repeat (repeat_redraw_fee): second doc redraw fee charge → 20.00.
- Scheduled 190.00; refund 250 − 190 = **60.00**, source 2b039f0f….
- Fall-back (scheduled_redraw_fee_and_refund alone): 250 − 150 = 100.00.

**C. Funding-month interest (customer).** Disbursement 10-01 after charge last day 09-30.
- Days 10-01..10-31 = 31 (10-01→12-01 61 days less November 30).
- Per diem 420858 × 6.625% / 365 = 76.3886 → **76.39**; interest 31 × 76.39 = 2368.09.
- Setoff (earlier_month_setoff + setoff_per_diem): open earlier-month days = 15 − 7 (returned-wire refund names the charge; "Refunds of every kind count here") = 8; 86.07 > 76.39 → setoff per diem 76.39; 8 × 76.39 = 611.12 ≤ 2368.09 → setoff 611.12.
- Redraw fee refunds (baseline step 5): 60.00.
- 2368.09 − 611.12 − 60.00 = 1696.97.
- Channel charge (payment_channel_charge + card_surcharge_schedule): latest loan fee entry credit_card; property CO → 2.0% → 33.94.
- Pays **1730.91**, period **2026-10-01..2026-10-31**, daily **76.39**.
- Fall-back (funding_month_interest_amount alone, after the redraw refund): 2368.09 − 60.00 = 2308.09 — different.

**D. Dispute decision (agent).**
- Disputed charge (disputed_charge_identification): filing names prepaid interest charge 5faf8448 → that charge. (Baseline: the latest-starting charge, which after the payment is the October entry.)
- Standing days (standing_days_of_disputed_charge): disbursement after the charge → 15 − 7 = 8.
- Refund per standing day (refund_per_standing_day): a funding-month charge now stands (period starts 10-01) → not the whole-daily tier; 86.07 > 76.39 → 9.68.
- Excess 8 × 9.68 = 77.44.
- Interest rate (interest_rate_on_dispute_excess): closing 412000 ≠ file 420858 → lock rate 6.625%.
- Interest days (interest_days_on_dispute_excess): filed Fri 10-09; 10-19 is business day 6 → >5 and ≤30 → 10-09 up to 10-19 = 10.
- Interest 77.44 × 6.625% × 10 / 365 = 0.1406 → 0.14. Refund **77.58**, resolution **refund_issued**.
- Fall-back (dispute_excess_and_refund_amount alone): refund per standing day zero → denied_correct_as_charged, 0.00.

### 6. Problem tree
- Root P1 dispute decision. Sentence (own hub, "## Prerequisite"): "A prepaid interest dispute is not decided until the closing's prepaid interest ledger carries a charge for the month in which the loan funded." State form.
- Hop P1 → P2 funding-month interest payment (customer write): **state-derived** — funding_month_interest_payment defines "the prepaid interest a borrower pays after closing for the month in which the loan funded" and "The payment is recorded as a prepaid interest charge for the funding-month interest days"; ledger shows no October entry; disbursement 10-01 after the charge's last day.
- Hop P2 → P3 returned-wire refund (agent): **state-derived** — "carries the returned-wire refund owed for the days a Larkspur-side return cost"; returned_wire_interest_refund: "One call adds one refund entry, marked as a refund for a returned-wire delay, to the closing's prepaid interest ledger".
- Hop P2 → P4 redraw fee refund (agent): **state-derived** — "the closing's fee ledger carries the redraw fee refund owed for a redraw charged above Larkspur's redraw schedule"; redraw_fee_refund: "adds one reversal entry to the closing's closing fee ledger".
- P3, P4: no prerequisite sentences. Order: P3, P4 → P2 → P1. No hop pre-solved (no tool of another problem, route or chain in a blocked document).

### Counter-proofs
- "Only decide the dispute": excluded by P1's sentence + empty October ledger. Deciding now would also hit the whole-daily tier (86.07 × 15 = 1291.05 + interest) — a different, wrong number.
- Paying funding-month interest before P3/P4: excluded by P2's two sentences; would misprice setoff (15 open days → 1145.85) and miss the 60.00.
- Late-funding refund for 09-16..09-23: excluded — late_funding_refund_amount requires disbursement within the charge; those days are open earlier-month days set off instead.
- Card at 2.5%: the card schedule row "CO | 2.0 percent" governs (see O3).
- Disputed charge = latest charge: excluded by the filing naming 5faf8448.
